input.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new Section 14.10 (Insurance) in Miscellaneous
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a standard insurance covenant, as the Agreement currently requires no coverage even though Commerce One performs installation, support and training services and handles Corio and Customer data. Our playbook position is CGL of USD 1M/2M, E&O of USD 2M and cyber liability of USD 5M with certificates on request; if helpful we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M as a fallback.

ops.text: 14.10 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) where Commerce One processes Corio or Customer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Commerce One shall provide certificates of insurance to Corio on request. The subsequent Section of this Section 14 shall be renumbered accordingly.
